ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity dark-gray/black pixels to high-intensity white/mottled pixels across the visible ventral surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white mottling is concentrated in the medial-central region of the left lobe and along the anterior margin of the right lobe; low-intensity dark pixels dominate the basal and posterior regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated aperture of approximately 100-110 degrees, forming a distinct V-shaped depression between the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations are visible along the left lobe trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits a more continuous linear boundary with fewer discrete indentations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced convex curvature fitted to the trailing edges of both lobes, tapering to acute distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized white punctate clusters are visible on the left lobe, specifically within the central white-mottled region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several parallel, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions are visible on the right lobe, extending from the leading edge toward the mid-lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular protrusions of brown/red biological material (biofouling) are present at both distal fluke tips; a significant secondary indentation is visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe near the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive macro-level biofouling/growth clusters attached to the extreme distal points of both the left and right lobes.
